rows.name: Amlwch Port
rows.description: On North pier; shown only when the harbour is practicable

rows.name: LYNUS or ELIAN POINT
rows.description: A white building, 36 ft. high. Light visible 8 secs.; eclipsed 2 secs. Masked to mark Middle Mouse and Dulas Rocks

rows.name: Beaumaris
rows.description: Bright light on pier

rows.name: Menai, Trwyn-Du Point
rows.description: Circular building, 96 ft. Large Fog Bell thrice every 15 secs.

rows.name: GREAT ORMES HEAD
rows.description: Light bright from N.W. by W. [?] W. to E., red from E. to E. [?] S.

rows.name: Llandudno
rows.description: Green light on pier-head. Lower red lt. when it is dangerous to come alongside.

rows.name: Rhyl
rows.description: Bright light on pier-head.

rows.name: AIR POINT
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: On old lighthouse, with red and white bands. It is red only within Hoyle Sand, from N.W. to E. by S. [?] S.; fog-bell.

rows.name: N.W. LIGHTSHIP
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: In 13 fathoms N.W. [?] W. 8½ miles from Horse Channel Fairway Buoy; a blue lt. every 2 hours; a black ball. In fogs, a bell.

rows.name: BAR LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: North 9½ miles from Upper Hoylake lt.-ho., & N.W. by W. [?] W. 8½ miles from Crosby lt.-ho. Fog-horn 3 times a minute or Bell.

rows.name: Hoylake
rows.description: White towers, 55 and 31 ft. In one, S.W. [?] S., 1,200 ft. apart, near the church

rows.name: Leasowe
rows.description: On the shore, between the Mersey and Dee

rows.name: BIDSTON
rows.description: A stone tower, 68 ft. high, on the hill; masked to N. by E. ½ E.

rows.name: ROCK
rows.character: One rev. br. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: A white tower, 94 ft. high. Also a fixed lt., while 11 ft. down Rock Channel; and another up the Mersey, from same tower. Fog-bell

rows.name: North Docks Wall
rows.description: Bright betw. S. by W. & N. by W. [?] W., red over Formby Bank E. of N. by W. [?] W. In line with Rock lt., bearing E. [?] S., indicates turning point betw. Horse & Rock Channels

rows.name: Birkenhead New Pier
rows.description: One bright fixed light

rows.name: Formby Lightvessel
rows.description: At the elbow of Crosby and Queen's Channels, in 50 ft. Hull black. Fog-bell

rows.name: Crosby Lightvessel
rows.description: In 48 ft., off the N.E. elbow of the Burbo Bank; a red ball. Fog-horn 3 times a min., or Bell

rows.name: Crosby Lighthouse
rows.description: Square tower, 74 ft., near the point

rows.name: Ribble River
rows.character: One intermittent light One bright Tide Light
rows.description: S.E. of Stanner Point; visible 3½ min.; dark ½ min. Tide lt. on new pier, from 2h. before to 1½h. after high water

rows.name: Lytham Harbour
rows.description: One fixed light, while the approach is practicable

rows.name: Blackpool Pier
rows.description: Green light seaward; bright to land

rows.name: Fleetwood
rows.description: North and South, 850 ft. apart; shown while 9 ft. Fog Bell, 3 strokes every minute

rows.name: Wyre River
rows.description: Pile lt.-ho. on N.E. end of North Wharf bank. Fog Bell
